entries.text: Added Text: Shared animation backend can update the text of Text nodes through AnimatedProps::text (70008bf90c by @bartlomiejbloniarz) iOS specific StatusBar: StatusBar.getVerticalBarEdgeIOS() and useVerticalBarEdgeIOS() (vertical bar on iPhone Duo) (5f9a64b3dd by @huntie) Changed Animated: Promote C++ Native Animated to stable (cxxNativeAnimatedEnabled) (a81429b9c2 by @zeyap) Animated: Enable the shared animation backend (useSharedAnimatedBackend, optimizedAnimatedPropUpdates) in canary and nightly builds. Both flags remain off by default in stable releases. (a3d675034b by @bartlomiejbloniarz) React Native DevTools: Add the React DevTools Suspense panel, update React DevTools to 8.0.0, and enable timeline frames by default (d9e48d8d50 by @huntie) React Native DevTools: Frame timings and screenshots in the Performance panel are enabled by default (dac56f15c7 by @huntie) Android specific Networking: fetch responses are no longer Base64-encoded for DevTools when no debugger is attached (f40b7acd9a by @hryhoriiK97) iOS specific CocoaPods: react-native spm add --deintegrate keeps the Podfile, and pod install stops with an error on an app that uses SwiftPM. react-native spm deinit and then pod install take an app back to CocoaPods. (b255245daa by @chrfalch) Fixed StyleSheet: Interpolate gradient color stops outside the 0–100% range instead of clamping them (7caaa57d39 by @intergalacticspacehighway) LogBox: Keep the inspector's message, code frames and stacks clear of horizontal sa

entries.text: Added React Native DevTools: Add support for inspecting WebSocket events in the Network panel (3d8a7a0296 by @huntie) Fixed Metro: Make Metro's transform cache shareable across checkouts by pointing asyncRequireModulePath at metro:runtime/modules/asyncRequire instead of an absolute path (2f9082fe08 by @janicduplessis) React Native DevTools: Fix the initiator of WebSocket connections opened from framework code, such as Metro's Fast Refresh socket, in the Network panel (d66f5230fd by @huntie) Android specific Renderer: Fix addViewAt crash when a view that a parent still holds with startViewTransition is inserted into another parent (45152f1f85 by @pawicao) Hermes V1 dSYMS: Debug Release ReactNativeDependencies dSYMs: Debug Release ReactNative Core dSYMs: Debug Release You can file issues or pick requests against this release here. entries.summary: Breaking; Accessibility: AccessibilityState::selected is now std::optional<bool> in C++ props, preserving an unset selected instead of coercing it to false (af4d8eb08a by Calvin Liu; Babel: Turn off…
entries.text: Breaking Accessibility: AccessibilityState::selected is now std::optional<bool> in C++ props, preserving an unset selected instead of coercing it to false (af4d8eb08a by Calvin Liu) Assets: Remove react-native/assets-registry. Use AssetRegistry from react-native and react-native/asset-utils instead. (56c48ac0eb by @huntie) Babel: Turn off babel/plugin-transform-destructuring plugin (73711b301e by @retyui) C++: Remove deprecated react/renderer/graphics/Geometry.h and react/renderer/graphics/conversions.h; include <React/Graphics.h> or <React/RendererCore.h> instead (1449daad5e by @j-piasecki) CLI: react-native/community-cli-plugin will no longer be auto-detected from react-native. It must now be specified in devDependencies. (b26baaeba0 by @huntie) CLI: Platform registration config for the Community CLI is removed from the react-native package. No breaking change with react-native-community/cli 21.x (required). (be9fbdd0d5 by @huntie) Image: Fix explicit fadeDuration being ignored on newly created Images (98d6795e6d by @bartlomiejbloniarz) JavaScript API: Mark unstable_batchedUpdates as deprecated (f6fc189b8c by @retyui) VirtualizedList: Fix SectionList and VirtualizedSectionList scrollToLocation to account for section headers and sticky headers correctly. (0c35f57447 by @amroaltah) Android specific C++: Remove deprecated rncore.h; include FBReactNativeSpec.h and call FBReactNativeSpec_ModuleProvider instead (d63648bac6 by @javache) New Architecture: Remove DefaultNewArchitect

entries.text: Added JSI: Forward createValueFromJsonUtf8 in RuntimeDecorator (b5eec4e4f3 by @mrousavy) JSI: Run the With hooks around WithRuntimeDecorator::createArrayBuffer (82def6ea4c by @mrousavy) JSI: Forward String::length in RuntimeDecorator and WithRuntimeDecorator (be567d270c by @mrousavy) Yoga: Fix flex shrink explosion when the shrink total is a positive float residual (24a3be5f99 by @intergalacticspacehighway) iOS specific SwiftPM: the build stops with a clear error when precompiled plugin frameworks and the Xcode project disagree, and the error says what to run. (a920e5db46 by @chrfalch) Changed JSI: Use createError in JSError and forward it in RuntimeDecorator (0cca3a1f77 by @mrousavy) iOS specific Build: Compile React Native's C/C++/Objective-C code with -O2 instead of -Os in Release, and Yoga and glog with -O2 in all builds, to match Android (60c817e925 by @chrfalch) SwiftPM: spm add and spm update write React Native's build settings to ReactNativeSPM/ReactNativeSPM.xcconfig and its build scripts to ReactNativeSPM/Scripts/, so a version bump no longer changes project.pbxproj. A configuration that uses its own xcconfig must now #include the generated file, and a target setting that hides React Native's value must add $(inherited). spm prints the exact fix in both cases. (cd89e98949 by @chrfalch) Text: Text without a background color no longer draws a transparent background (0bd33261d1 by @hryhoriiK97) Fixed LogBox: Fix bottom notification appearance/touch targets on iPhone Du
